title: Rule simulator-drive-lease knows the simulator MCP's real read-action names
why: Rule simulator-drive-lease raises a read false alarm, because it does not know the simulator MCP's real read-action names.
note: Needs a session on the owner's Mac to read the names. From lane sim-lease-gaps ([ended:lane:-sim-lease-gaps]) via the coordinator, 19:06 CST Nov 7.
